integrity: Exact symbolic proofs accompany computational finite tests; the tests do not certify arbitrary finite groups. Literature distinctions and remaining priority risks are disclosed.
limitations: The top-layer statement concerns automorphisms fixing every other subset; no classification of all automorphisms for general finite groups is claimed. The small-group automorphism statements concern only C3 and the Klein four group. Absolute independent priority is unverified.
title: Exceptional co-singleton symmetries of finite-group power semigroups
